description: dev-setup: give each session the delivery role of the person for this repository. Each command tries python3, then python, then py -3, because python3 on Windows can be a Store alias that is not Python.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/setup/scripts/rolestore.py" hook || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/setup/scripts/rolestore.py" hook || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/setup/scripts/rolestore.py" hook
